traits.description: Picks up new tasks and routes fast — needs far less training time.
Keeps grinding through the whole shift without slacking off.
Shows up on time and gets the job done, day in and day out.
Works well with the crew and lends a hand wherever it's needed.
Rarely mispicks and catches mistakes before they ever ship.
Already licensed to run powered equipment safely on the floor.
Clocks in early and never holds up the start of the shift.
Handles heavy cases all day long without wearing down.
Keeps a cool head even when the dock gets slammed.
Keeps their area tidy and their pallets squared away.
Follows procedure and avoids accidents out on the floor.
Blazes through pick lists with a high cases-per-hour rate.
Remembers slot locations and SKUs without looking them up.
Figures out jams and snags without flagging down a lead.
Thrives on the morning shift and beats the daily rush.
Leaves every aisle cleaner than they found it.
Hungry to prove themselves and climb the ladder.
Tackles the bulkiest freight that others tend to avoid.
Spots damaged goods and label errors almost instantly.
Builds tall, stable pallets that never topple in transit.
